findings.scope: Unmodified openpi pi05_libero config at pinned commit: pi05=True, discrete_state_input=False, extra_delta_transform=False. State tokenization and continuous suffix state path disabled; output delta transform absent. State shape remains used. Same finite shape, RGB/prompt/noise assumed.

findings.result: OpenVLA-OFT state-value path present, usefulness untested
Audited 40 goal forms have no explicit absolute end-effector orientation goal. This does not establish orientation-insensitive dynamics/control, nor cover all 130 LIBERO tasks.
Native prompt is derived from task filename; raw BDDL language may differ. Goal predicate must be inspected independently of task title.
Report-only perturbation cannot be equated with controller feedback corruption: controller reads simulator pose, independent of the policy packet.
